purpose: Historical options-stage validation only. No live trade authority.
episodeSet: All 14 S001 v1 episodes produced by the unchanged rule across 2025-01-02 through 2026-09-09.

structure.longPutStrikeRule: Nearest whole-dollar strike to SPY confirmation-bar close; 0.50 ties round upward.
structure.expirationRule: Same calendar date as signal episode.
structure.missingContractOrBar: NO_FILL; do not substitute another strike or expiration.

executionModel.referencePrice: 5-minute option aggregate close at the required timestamp.
executionModel.entry: Long leg BUY at reference plus penalty; short leg SELL at reference minus penalty.
executionModel.exit: Long leg SELL at reference minus penalty; short leg BUY at reference plus penalty.

interpretationLimit: A PASS is an aggregate-bar options-stage result, not a final NBBO executable-edge claim. Historical bid/ask confirmation remains required before any live-capital consideration.
antiOverfitRule: No strike width, DTE, entry time, exit horizon, cost assumption, or signal threshold may be changed after options performance is inspected. Any material change requires a new preregistered version.
